verdict.rationale: The pack shows a native Jira integration exists (its API lets you inspect 'Jira integrations configured in your workspace'), implying at least one pre-built connector, but there's no evidence describing a one-click marketplace of common tools (Slack, Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) or describing the actual setup flow's simplicity — most of the pack instead documents developer-facing REST/Webhooks/MCP APIs for building custom integrations, which is a heavier lift than 'a few clicks'. Missing for 10: evidence of a native integrations directory/marketplace, screenshots or docs of simple click-to-connect setup for popular tools beyond Jira, and confirmation of no-code configuration.
